provenance.reworkedBy: Txema Vicente (manual cleanup), then Codex (AI coding agent) under his direction using data from the Honda manual
provenance.source: Cleaned up by hand by Txema Vicente over several hours, then substantially reworked by Codex under his direction using data from the Honda manual, starting from a low-quality base mesh; almost none of the original geometry remains. Base mesh: the user-supplied interceptor.glb. Prepared and visually approved on 2026-10-08.
edits: 2026-10-08 scripts/prepare-vfr800-cockpit.mjs: the existing fairing mirrors split into mirror_L / mirror_R nodes under Body; static needles, hubs and speedometer tick marks removed for the live instruments; gauge and lamp anchors added; windscreen switched from transmission to alpha blending with a neutral smoke-grey tint and a slight reflection (extras.nabla.envIntensity 0.35); a new neutral mirror chrome (base 0.95 grey, metallic 1, roughness 0.03) only on the fork stanchions, the silencer can and its end cap; the exhaust headers and the engine cases behind the radiator moved to the satin aluminium of the top triple clamp; discs, brake tracks, chain, sprockets, radiator, swingarm and mirror glass keep their authored materials.

2026-10-08 natural chrome (Txema's review: too bright and mirror-like): the mirror chrome's roughness 0.03 -> 0.12 and extras.nabla.envIntensity 1.25 -> 0.75, patched in place in the material JSON (same byte length; scripts/prepare-vfr800-cockpit.mjs carries the new values).
provenance.note: Provenance as stated by Txema Vicente. No license name is recorded for the artwork; the repository's MIT code license covers code only.
